hook.description: A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open.
hook.evidence: The sudden, jarring sound creates immediate tension and curiosity about the intruder.

hook.description: Extreme close-up of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering over a jagged scar.
hook.evidence: The intimate, vulnerable visual of the scars immediately establishes the show's romantic and dramatic tone.
